description:
Create a production die-line for a 60mm x 60mm x 100mm packaging box in LibreCAD. 

Starting from a blank drawing (Millimeters), create two layers:
1. 'CUT' (Color: Red, Linetype: Continuous)
2. 'FOLD' (Color: Blue, Linetype: Dashed)

Draw the net of the box with the following specifications (coordinates relative to bottom-left of first panel at 0,0):
- 4 main panels, each 60mm wide x 100mm high.
- Top and Bottom flaps extending 30mm from the main body.
- A 15mm wide glue tab on the right side (next to the 4th panel).
- The glue tab must have chamfered corners.
- Crease lines (FOLD layer) must be dashed.
- Cut lines (CUT layer) must be continuous red.

Save the file to '/home/ga/Documents/LibreCAD/box_dieline.dxf'.
